description: Rank Hello, AI's tracked frontier models for a task. Same scoring as GET /api/recommend: task match 40%, Elo 35%, input cost 15%, context 10% (Elo 55%, cost 25%, context 20% when no task matches). Only rated models rank; unrated ones are listed separately. score is an ordering aid, not a quality measure.

limit.description: How many ranked rows to return, 1 to 10. Default 3.

max_cost.description: Maximum USD per 1 million input tokens; models above it are excluded.

min_context.description: Minimum context window in tokens; models below it are excluded.

provider.description: Provider name, case-insensitive exact match (for example Anthropic, Google, xAI).

task.description: Use case, matched against the category names: Overall Preference, Coding & Engineering, Hard Reasoning & Science, Honest Daily Use. Examples: coding, reasoning, overall, daily.

name: recommend_models
title: Recommend models for a task
